name: Truncated Gradient Updates for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A gradient modification technique that applies a truncated gradient update to 'dead' Gaussians (those with low opacity) to enable long-range movement and convergence, addressing vanishing gradients in dynamic scenes or poor initialization.
summary: Truncated Gradient Updates modifies gradients for low-opacity Gaussians to enable long-range movement, distinguishing itself by using Mahalanobis distance and opacity thresholds to prevent divergence.
